name: Furnas County, NE
findings: Furnas County has 22 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (83% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Furnas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list public events, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Furnas County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
